title: Two days to prepare.
lines: Send the important message now.
Back up your files, confirm your bookings, read the fine print.
Mercury turns retrograde in Scorpio on Saturday.
caption:
Mercury turns retrograde on Saturday, Oct 24, at 21° Scorpio, and turns direct on Nov 13. ☿

Tradition reads retrogrades as a time to review, revisit and repair rather than launch. Before it starts:
• Send the message that matters
• Back up your phone and files
• Confirm bookings and travel
• Read contracts twice

Where it lands in your chart decides what it reviews for you. The Oracle shows you, house by house: link in bio.

title: The Sun enters Scorpio.
lines: Four weeks of depth, truth, and what lies beneath the surface.
Fixed water: loyal, intense, transforming.
caption:
The Sun enters Scorpio today. ♏

Scorpio is fixed water: the deep well. Four weeks for honesty, intimacy, and letting something old transform. What you have been avoiding may ask to be looked at, gently.

Which house does Scorpio rule in your chart? That's where this season works on you. Ask the Oracle: link in bio.

title: Mercury retrograde begins.
lines: 21° Scorpio, until November 13.
Review, revisit, repair.
Re-read before you send.
caption:
Mercury is retrograde from today until Nov 13, in Scorpio. ☿

In Scorpio, the review goes deep: old secrets, unfinished conversations, shared money, trust. A good time to return to what you left half-said.

What helps: slow down, double-check details, and let delays protect you rather than frustrate you.

title: What do you value?
lines: The Full Moon lights up comfort, money, the body, and what you want to keep.
A moment to release what costs you your peace.
caption:
Full Moon in Taurus tonight (Oct 25 in the Americas, Oct 26 in Europe and beyond). ☽

Taurus asks what you truly value: your body, your security, your time, your peace. A Full Moon shows what has grown since the spring, and what you are ready to release.

Try this: write down one thing you want to keep, and one thing that costs you too much.

The Oracle shows which part of your chart this Moon lights up: link in bio.

title: Love, under review.
lines: Venus moved back into Libra yesterday and turns direct on November 14.
Old connections, fairness, and what you really want from a partner.
caption:
Venus is retrograde and moved back into Libra yesterday. It turns direct on Nov 14. ♀

Venus retrograde reviews love, beauty and value. In Libra: partnership, fairness, and the balance between giving and receiving. Old connections may resurface. Notice what they teach you before you decide anything.

title: Fire signs
lines: Aries · Leo · Sagittarius
Spirit, drive, and the spark of life.
Gifts: courage, enthusiasm, generosity. Practice: pacing yourself so the flame lasts.
caption:
The elements, part 1: FIRE. 🜂 Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.

Fire acts first and understands afterwards. Warm, direct, moved by inspiration.
✦ Gifts: courage, enthusiasm, leadership, generosity
✦ Shadow: impatience, burnout, a quick temper
✦ What helps: movement, sunlight, play, a goal worth chasing

Your Sun sign is one element of many. The app weighs your whole chart and shows your balance of all four: link in bio.

#firesigns #aries #leo #sagittarius #astrology

title: Earth signs
lines: Taurus · Virgo · Capricorn
The body, the senses, and the material world.
Gifts: patience, skill, loyalty. Practice: letting yourself change course.
caption:
The elements, part 2: EARTH. 🜃 Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.

Earth trusts what it can touch, measure and build. Patient, grounded, practical.
✦ Gifts: reliability, skill, good sense with money and time
✦ Shadow: stubbornness, over-caution, worry about security
✦ What helps: routines, nature, cooking, finishing one concrete thing

How much earth is in your chart? Ask the Oracle "What are my elements?": link in bio.

title: Water signs

Feeling, memory, and the unseen.
Gifts: empathy, intuition, care. Practice: telling your feelings from other people's.
caption:

title: The veil is thin.
lines: Halfway between the equinox and the solstice.
A night for remembering, for honouring what has ended, and for asking the deeper question.
caption:
Oct 31: the cross-quarter night halfway between the equinox and the solstice, with the Sun in Scorpio and Mercury retrograde. ☽

Many traditions call this the time when the veil is thin: for remembering, honouring endings, and listening inward.

If there's a question you have been carrying, tonight is a good night to ask it. The Oracle answers from your chart: link in bio.

title: Cardinal · Fixed · Mutable
lines: Cardinal starts. Fixed holds. Mutable adapts.
Every sign is one element and one mode.
Scorpio, this season: fixed water.
caption:
Every sign has an element AND a mode. ✦

◆ CARDINAL (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn): the energy of beginnings. Initiative and leadership.
◆ FIXED (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius): the energy of holding. Loyalty and endurance.
◆ MUTABLE (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces): the energy of change. Flexibility and curiosity.

Which one leads your chart? Ask the Oracle "Am I cardinal, fixed, or mutable?": link in bio.

#cardinal #fixed #mutable #astrology #zodiacsigns

lines: A person, a project, an old idea.

caption:
